capacity_scaling.criterion: at approximately fixed active unique parameters (within 5% of the smallest rung), fit log(cold bytes per token) against log(total accessible capacity); the slope's 95% CI upper bound must be below 1

no_hidden_teacher.criterion: teacher_calls_at_inference == 0 and a replay-court receipt (P7.5) is named; an external adapter that cannot expose this is recorded as unverified, never as satisfied

physical_pareto.criterion: no control row may dominate the arm on success, cold bytes per token, p95 latency and residency simultaneously

3B-8B quantised local baseline.reason: no such checkpoint is present locally; a row is emitted with unavailable fields and a reason, never a fabricated number

bootstrap.kind: paired percentile, items resampled within category, categories weighted equally

primary.decision_rule: improve the composite by at least 10% relative with a paired 95% CI lower bound above zero, and regress no category by more than 0.05 absolute
primary.definition: equal weight per category; the arithmetic mean inside each category; categories are reported separately and never pooled
primary.endpoint: category-balanced mean verified task success on the 144-task suite

sealed_holdback.policy: Frozen before any arm run. Never used for tuning, prompt selection, few-shot examples, checkpoint selection or threshold selection. Scored once per revision, only with the unlock flag and the registered sealed hash, and reported once with its unlock record.

supersedes.reason: P14.4 doubled the scored suite from 72 to 144 tasks, added the per-category minimum of 18 and froze the 24-item sealed holdback. The primary threshold, the decision rule, the bootstrap seed and resample count, and the trio rule are unchanged.

trio.rule: a transfer claim requires success on every surface (rust, numeric-graph, logic) with the per-surface breakdown reported; results are never pooled across surfaces
